name: 49420 · Hart, MI
findings: ZIP 49420 (Hart) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49420 (Hart) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49420 (Hart) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
